name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Schiestlhof
beschreibung: The Schiestlhof offers holiday apartments in Thiersee with panoramic mountain views. These modern apartments feature a fireplace and a kitchenette. The farm is home to goats, chickens, and rabbits, which are especially popular with children. In summer, the garden invites guests to play and barbecue. Hiking trails lead directly from the farm into the surrounding alpine scenery. The on-site cheese dairy can also be visited on guided tours.
